notes: The supplied *of* in *we heard of it* is the preposition the English verb needs to reach its own object suffix, which rule 44 expressly places in the verb's unit rather than with the suffix.

No article morpheme stands in `בִּשְׂדֵי־יָעַר`, so both written *the*s are supplied and each goes before the word it determines (rules 29 and 15). Both margins (*Ephraim*, *Jaar*) were read and set aside under rule 38.
